name: Scalar Field Connectivity Obfuscation
description: Replaces the explicit topological guarantee of being a connected tree with an equivalent property from discrete calculus: any scalar field with zero gradient across all available lines must be globally constant. When combined with the constraint that $m$ is the minimum number of lines required for this property ($m = n - 1$), it mathematically guarantees the network is a tree. Models relying on explicit graph terminology will fail to recognize the tree structure, likely interpreting it as a continuous optimization or general graph problem.
